summary: Cooking school in Chiang Mai running morning and afternoon Thai cooking classes with a market tour and garden visit.

facts.label: Course price
facts.value: Normal price starts at 1,000 Baht, with an air-conditioned upgrade option
facts.quote: The normal price starts at 1,000 Baht

facts.label: Class length
facts.value: About 3 to 4 hours including garden visit and meal
facts.quote: The class takes approximately 3-4 hours (including the garden visit and meal).

facts.label: What is covered
facts.value: Market tour, garden walk, cooking 3 dishes plus dessert and Thai tea
facts.quote: market tour, garden walk, cooking 3 dishes + dessert + Thai tea
